Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃：delete很，delete也
- 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况：delete你的，redundant; 是很麻烦的情况
- 但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很不知道：不知道，A negated knowledge verb should not be modified by 很; use the plain negative form here. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的人：古代的人们，This refers to a concrete group of people in ancient times, so 人们 is needed rather than the generic noun 人. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 也什么植物不能吃：也不知道什么植物不能吃，Also must be followed by a verb phrase; repeating 不知道 makes the second part parallel with the first. [teacher rule: ye_vp]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 很麻烦的情况：是一种很麻烦的情况，The noun phrase needs 是 to function as the predicate after the preceding statement. [rule: none]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处：这对你的身体有坏处，The action has just been mentioned, so use 这 for close re-occurrence instead of repeating the full phrase. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个人，神农：有一个叫神农的人，A character’s first mention should introduce the name clearly together with a full noun phrase. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: 很 cannot modify the negated knowledge verb 不知道 here.
古代的人 can refer generally to people in ancient times and does not necessarily require 人们.
也 cannot directly precede the noun phrase 什么植物不能吃; repeating 不知道 makes it a verb phrase.
很麻烦的情况 is only a noun phrase and needs 是 to serve as the predicate.
Repeating 吃不安全的植物 is acceptable here, and the proposed correction still retains the teacher-marked redundant 你的.
神农 is being mentioned for the first time and should be introduced with a clear full noun phrase.
